test_drag_camera_to_tile.title: Verify a camera thumbnail can be dragged to an empty tile.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Views > Empty Grid State
steps.expected: Empty Grid State page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for data to finish loading (spinners, skeleton loaders disappear)
steps.expected: All data sections have loaded completely

steps.action: Locate empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text on the page
steps.expected: empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text is visible in the expected location

steps.action: Verify the data values are populated and not empty or showing placeholders
steps.expected: Actual data values are displayed (not 'N/A', 'Loading...', or '---')

steps.action: Verify the data format is correct (numbers, dates, labels, etc.)
steps.expected: Data is formatted according to the expected display format

steps.action: Verify empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text is displayed as expected
steps.expected: empty grid tile displays Drag & Drop Camera here text is displayed as expected

steps.action: Refresh the page and verify the data displays consistently
steps.expected: Same data appears after page refresh

test_drag_camera_by_name_to_tile.title: Verify a specific camera can be dragged to a tile by name

steps.action: On Views, expand the configured site and show its cameras.
steps.expected: The site's camera thumbnails are listed.

steps.action: Drag the configured camera's thumbnail onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile fills and the camera's live video plays as a moving picture, not a still.

test_drag_saved_view_to_tile.title: Verify a saved view can be dragged from My Views to an empty tile

steps.action: Create a saved view (the automation makes one through the API), reload Views and open My Views.
steps.expected: The saved view is listed.

steps.action: Drag the saved view onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile fills with the view's content, or the view opens as a new tab.

test_drag_location_to_tile.title: Verify a location/site can be dragged to an empty tile (shows all cameras)

steps.action: On Views, in the Devices panel, drag the configured site's row onto an empty tile.
steps.expected: The site's cameras load into the grid and empty tiles fill.

test_drag_map_to_tile.title: Verify a map can be dragged to an empty tile.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Maps
steps.expected: Maps page loads without errors

steps.action: Verify the page displays any existing items
steps.expected: Page content loads (list, table, or empty state)

steps.action: Click the create/add button for selecting a map adds it to an empty grid tile
steps.expected: Creation form or dialog opens

steps.action: Verify all required form fields are present and empty/default
steps.expected: Form fields are displayed with correct labels and placeholders

steps.action: Fill in all required fields with valid test data
steps.expected: All fields accept the input without errors

steps.action: Fill in any optional fields if applicable
steps.expected: Optional fields accept input

steps.action: Review the filled form for correctness
steps.expected: All entered data is displayed correctly in the form

steps.action: Click the Save/Submit/Create button
steps.expected: Form is submitted and a success message or indicator appears

steps.action: Verify the newly created selecting a map adds it to an empty grid tile appears in the list or view
steps.expected: The new selecting a map adds it to an empty grid tile is visible with the correct data

steps.action: Verify no duplicate entries were created
steps.expected: Only one instance of the new selecting a map adds it to an empty grid tile exists

test_add_channel_to_tile.title: Verify a channel can be added to an empty tile

steps.action: On Views, click the Channels tab in the left panel.
steps.expected: The panel lists the tenant's channels. With none the test skips naming that.

steps.action: Hover the first channel and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: The channel takes a tile: one fewer empty tile, or its content shows.

test_multiple_cameras_to_multiple_tiles.title: Verify multiple cameras can be added to multiple tiles.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Views > Camera Grid
steps.expected: Camera Grid page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render
steps.expected: All page elements are loaded (no spinners or skeleton loaders)

steps.action: Scroll to the area where multiple camera tiles should appear
steps.expected: The relevant section of the page is in view

steps.action: Locate multiple camera tiles on the page
steps.expected: multiple camera tiles is visible on the page

steps.action: Verify multiple camera tiles displayed simultaneously in the grid
steps.expected: multiple camera tiles displayed simultaneously in the grid
